source.name: SQLCostReader
source.param: 'select c."cost", c."ido" as "type_id", o."name" as "type_name", c."id" as "price_id" from "OrgCost" c, "Org" o where c."ido" = o."id" and (o."id" in (select "id" from "AgentOrgs" where "userid"= ' + "'" + $user.id + "')" + ' or o."id" in (select "name" from "OrgFolder$items" where "OrgFolder$userid" = ' + "'" + $user.id + "'))"

source.name: SQLQuery
source.param: 'select d1."date", "qty", d1."id_i" from (select "date", sum("qty") as "qty", di."id" as "id_i" from "Delivery" d, "Delivery$items" di where d."number" = di."Delivery$number" and di."Delivery$id" = ' + "'$01'" + ' and d."date" > ToDate("' + FormatDate(AdjustDate(Now(),-6,"month"),"DD.MM.YYYY") + '") group by "date", di."id") d1' + ' inner join (select max(d."date") as "date", di."id" as "id_i" from "Delivery" d, "Delivery$items" di where d."number"= di."Delivery$number" and di."Delivery$id" = ' + "'$01'" + ' and d."date" > ToDate("' + FormatDate(AdjustDate(Now(),-6,"month"),"DD.MM.YYYY") + '") group by di."id") d2' + ' on d1."date" = d2."date" and d1."id_i" = d2."id_i"'

source.name: SQLQuery
source.param: 'select di."id", di."qty", di."sum", di."party", di."expired", d."number", d."date", d."firm" from "Delivery$items" di, "Delivery" d where d."number" = di."Delivery$number" and d."id" = di."Delivery$id" and di."Delivery$id" = ' + "'$01'" + ' and di."expired" >= ToDate("$02")'

source.name: SQLQuery
source.param: 'select dl.* from (select d.*, di."id" as "id_i", di."qty" as "qty", di."cost" as "cost" from "Order" d, "Order$items" di where d."id" in($01) and d."created" = di."Order$created" and d."userid" = di."Order$userid" and d."created" >= ToDate("' + FormatDate(Now(),"DD.MM.YYYY") + '") ) as "dl" inner join (select max(dq."created") as "created", dq."firmCode", dq."id" from "Order" dq where dq."id" in($01) and dq."created" >= ToDate("' + FormatDate(Now(),"DD.MM.YYYY") + '") group by dq."id", dq."firmCode") as ds on dl."firmCode" = ds."firmCode" and dl."created" = ds."created" and dl."id" = ds."id" order by "created", "id"'

source.name: SQLQuery
source.param: 'select dl.* from (select d.*, di."id" as "id_i", di."qty" as "qty", di."sum" as "sum" from "Delivery" d, "Delivery$items" di where d."id" in($01) and d."id" = di."Delivery$id" and d."number" = di."Delivery$number" and d."date" >= ToDate("' + FormatDate(AdjustDate(Now(),-1,"month"),"DD.MM.YYYY") + '") ) as "dl" inner join (select max(dq."date") as "date", dq."id", dq."firm" from "Delivery" dq where dq."id" in($01) and dq."date" >= ToDate("' + FormatDate(AdjustDate(Now(),-1,"month"),"DD.MM.YYYY") + '") group by dq."id", dq."firm") as "ds" on dl."firm" = ds."firm" and dl."date" = ds."date" and dl."id" = ds."id" order by "number"'

source.name: SQLQuery
source.param: 'select distinct o."address", o."block", o."costype", o."id", o."ido", o."name", o."noDrop", o."stop", o."calcDebet", o."formatTT", o."idChannel", o."idRetailer", c."phone" as "phone", c."name" as "FIO" from "Org" o left join "Org$contacts" as c on o."id" = c."Org$id" order by o."id"'
